faqs.q: What are Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters used for?
faqs.a: Enerpac NC nut cutters are hydraulic tools that cut a seized or corroded nut off a bolt without damaging the bolt thread, in seven models from 5 to 90 ton capacity. They are listed on the [nut splitters and cutters shelf](/c/nut-splitters-nut-cutters).

faqs.q: How do I read the Enerpac NC part numbers?
faqs.a: The four digits after NC give the hexagon range, and the rows show the capacity and hex size: NC1319 is 5 ton for hexagons up to .75", NC2432 is 15 ton up to 1.13" and NC6075 is 90 ton up to 2.88".

faqs.q: Which nut sizes do the Enerpac NC cutters handle?
faqs.a: The seven models cut hexagons up to .75", .94", 1.13", 1.56", 2.00", 2.25" and 2.88", in order of capacity 5, 10, 15, 20, 35, 50 and 90 ton. Pick the model by the hexagon size and bolt grade it is rated for.

faqs.q: What capacity does each Enerpac NC nut cutter have?
faqs.a: NC1319 5 ton, NC1924 10 ton, NC2432 15 ton, NC3241 20 ton, NC4150 35 ton, NC5060 50 ton and NC6075 90 ton. Choose the cutter whose hexagon range covers your nut with margin.

faqs.q: What pump and hose do the Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters need?
faqs.a: The Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters are hydraulic tools, so they need a pump and hose rated for the working pressure, such as one of the sets listed with a pump. The listing has 7 part numbers, for example NC1319, NC1924 and NC2432.

faqs.q: Does Indus supply test documents with the Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters?
faqs.a: No certificate or approval is listed for the Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters. If your job needs a test report or certificate of conformity, state it on your [request](/contact) and we confirm what is available before supply.

faqs.q: What else do I need with the Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters?
faqs.a: Besides the tool you need a hydraulic pump and hose; see the [bolt tensioning, nut splitters and flange tools guide](/blog/bolt-tensioning-nut-splitters-and-flange-tools) for how the tools fit with tensioners and spreaders.

faqs.q: How do I choose a size of the Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters?
faqs.a: Pick a nut splitter or cutter by the hexagon size and bolt grade it is rated for; the size table gives the range of each model. For the Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters, The size table gives capacity 5 to 90.

faqs.q: Where are the Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters used?
faqs.a: The Enerpac NC hydraulic nut cutters are used to remove seized, corroded or heat-damaged nuts on flanges and heavy machinery without cutting the bolt. See the [torque wrenches](/c/hydraulic-torque-wrenches) for tightening the replacement.

faqs.q: How do the NC nut cutters differ from the NS nut splitters?
faqs.a: The NC range is 5 to 90 ton for hexagons up to 2.88", while the [NS nut splitters](/p/enerpac-ns-hydraulic-nut-splitters) are 103 and 192 ton for hexagons up to 5.38", sold as sets with an air, electric or hand pump.

faqs.q: What are Enerpac NS hydraulic nut splitters used for?
faqs.a: Enerpac NS nut splitters are large hydraulic tools that split a seized nut off a bolt, in 103 and 192 ton capacity, as a splitter alone or as a set with an air, electric or hand pump. They are listed on the [nut splitters and cutters shelf](/c/nut-splitters-nut-cutters).

faqs.q: How do I read the Enerpac NS part numbers?
faqs.a: The suffix shows the pump in the set: SA is a set with an air pump, SE with an electric pump and SH with a hand pump, so NS70105SA is the 103 ton splitter with an air pump. NS110115 is the 192 ton splitter alone.

faqs.q: Which nut sizes do the Enerpac NS splitters handle?
faqs.a: NS70105 handles hexagons up to 4.25", NS110115 up to 4.63", and the NS110130 sets up to 5.38". Pick the model by the hexagon size and bolt grade it is rated for.

faqs.q: What capacity does each Enerpac NS nut splitter have?
faqs.a: The NS70105 sets are 103 ton, and the NS110115 and NS110130 models are 192 ton. The 103 ton model has three set versions: air, electric and hand pump.
